title: New Napkin Problem
content: Figure 7.5 gives an identifiable effect of X on Y even though no observed set satisfies the back-door criterion and no observed mediator satisfies the front-door criterion. The two unobserved variables induce distinct W-X and W-Y confounding relationships.

variables.name: U1
variables.content: The unobserved common cause of W and Y.

variables.name: U2
variables.content: The unobserved common cause of W and X.

variables.name: W
variables.content: An observed cause of Z confounded with X and Y.

variables.name: Z
variables.content: The observed child of W and cause of X.

variables.name: X
variables.content: The treatment whose causal effect on Y is sought.

arrows.because: Figure 7.5 makes U1 a hidden cause of W.
